description: Defines the ConsoleMessage class which models console messages within the Playwright core server, including properties such as message type, text, arguments, location, associated page, and worker.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message, encapsulating information such as message type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page object associated with this console message, or null if none.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Returns the Worker object associated with this console message, or null if none.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the console message as a string.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the text of the console message. If the text is not explicitly set, it constructs the text by joining previews of the arguments.

methods.name: args
methods.description: Returns the array of JSHandle objects representing arguments to the console message.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location information (url, line number, column number) where the console message was generated.
